notes.title: Lux Alliance is now available!
notes.content:
Lux Alliance is now released on steam and available for your world domination enjoyment!

A few items we snuck into the final build:

- preference to allow AI players to surrender (when they are vastly out-numbered)

- steam async notifications for multi-player games with long timers. You can join a MP game, close the game client, and steam will notify you when your turn is ready to play!

- better international support (Chinese, Russian, German, Spanish, French, ...)

Hope you like it!
